mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.inspection_order_id, s.inspect_item_id, ii.name as inspect_item_name, s.planned_quantity, s.unit_id, s.sample_count, s.sampling_method, s.sampling_location, s.sampling_description, s.remark, s.sample_id, s.sample_no, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM lm_inspection_sampling s LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON s.inspect_item_id = ii.id WHERE s.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.create_time ASC
